thread:
leah: quick sync: sales pushed back — three customers want console-level cost per-route + trace link to support internal chargebacks. want MVP in ~5-6 weeks.

tom: clarifying Q — is the ask realtime billing or daily reconciliation? that drives infra.

leah: they said realtime is nice but daily reconciled view is acceptable to start. main ask: be able to point at a trace from the cost chart.

ravi: ok. minimal surface: (1) add `route_id` + `customer_id` to trace/span tags, (2) pre-aggregate daily token counts per route, (3) show per-route cost tile and a link to sampled traces.

emily: UX: tile with sparkline + top 3 callers, drilldown modal that lists sampled traces and a quick filter by error/high-latency. mockups I can do in 2 days.

carlos: infra note: attribution needs to handle batching & model-step shared tokens. propose we: store request-level token_estimate and batch attribution is prorated by token_estimate. implement counters in runtime. overhead should be <1% CPU.

ravi: sampling strategy: index all error traces + traces with latency > p95 + uniform 0.05% sample for normal. that keeps query costs low but surfaces problematic cases.

leah: launch criteria draft:
- console shows per-route daily cost and 7-day trend
- each cost row links to sampled traces for that route (click -> trace list)
- traces contain `route_id` and `customer_id` tags
- token_estimate present per request for batch prorating
- error/high-latency indexing enabled with sampling config
- docs + customer beta guide
- basic acceptance test for tenant isolation of telemetry

tom: delivery plan (tight): week1 header propagation + token counters + prod-safe opt-in flag; week2 storage hooks + pre-agg pipeline; week3 dashboard + linking; week4 private beta + iterate.

emily: prioritization note: this competes with infra debt and feature work. customers that asked for this represent ~12% of committed ARR for Dedicated. recommend escalate prioritization to next PLG review.

leah: agree. proposed resourcing: allocate one eng pair + one analytics eng + one designer for 6 weeks, treat as customer-driven sprint.

carlos: question on cost calc: do we show estimated unit costs (GPU/token) or just currency cost? finance prefers currency. we can expose both behind a toggle.

ravi: also need to add a reconciliation job to compare estimated vs actual billing at day end. estimated will power UI; reconciled can be generated overnight.

billing-bot: scheduled job created: `reconcile_daily_costs` runs at 03:00 UTC daily.

emily: ux gotcha: customers want to export per-route CSV for internal accounting. add CSV export to MVP if trivial.

leah: we'll include CSV export as stretch — only enable when reconcile job completes.

tom: risks: 1) unexpected trace volume growth if we index more than planned; 2) attribution disputes due to batching heuristics. mitigations: opt-in per-customer for full indexing and expose attribution method in docs.

emily: acceptance criteria for Beta: customers can see per-route daily cost, click to view sampled traces for that route, and download a CSV.

leah: action list: 
- tom: implement header propagation + opt-in flag (week1)
- ravi: sampling/indexing config + pre-agg pipeline (week1-2)
- carlos: token_estimate counters + batch prorating logic (week1)
- emily: mockups + CSV UX (48h)
- leah: customer comms + create beta list (today)

billing-bot: noted: tagging thread with `beta:cost-attribution` and creating beta channel when ready.

leah: ok let's ship this as a focused sprint. planning sync Wednesday 9am PT. ping me if anyone hits scope creep.
